Name: One Season At A Time (greenhouse season controller)
Author: Larvuk
Description:
[size=4][b]Farming in the greenhouse is too easy for your skills?[/b][/size]

This mod adds a device inside your greenhouse, handling heat and humidity.
So you will have to choose only one season at a time to grow crops in your greenhouse.
[b][size=4]

Greenhouse Controller Machine[/size][/b]

The device simulating seasons in your greenhouse needs energy cells to work (deactivable and configurable with 3 difficulty levels). Craft them and load them inside it.
Move it around with your axe or pickaxe just like a chest, so your visual harmony is preserved.
Multiple greenhouses (like with SVE) means multiple Greenhouse Controllers you can use with different settings.


[b][size=4]Only spring crops in your non-greenhouse buildings[/size][/b]

Not to let you replace your greenhouse with dozen of garden pots in your children's bedroom, the mod limits non-greenhouse buildings to spring crops (deactivable)


[size=4][b]Low quality crops[/b][/size]

If you're still too good at the game, you can lower the quality of crops that grow in greenhouses and in other buildings.


Have fun!


[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]

Made with SDV 1.6.
Supposed to be compatible with most mods adding greenhouses, and with most custom greenhouse interiors, but I can't check everything and it might not work with some of them - just tell me in the comments then.

Uses Harmony, and impacts the following methods (there might be conflicts with mods impacting the same methods):
[font=Courier New]Crop.newDay()
Crop.Harvest()[/font][font=Courier New]
HoeDirt.DrawOptimized()
HoeDirt.canPlantThisSeedHere()
GameLocation.SeedsIgnoreSeasonsHere()
GameLocation.GetSeason()
Chest.isEmpty()
Chest.updateWhenCurrentLocation()
Chest.checkForAction()
Chest.ShowMenu()[/font]
